summary: AXIA Energia filed a Form 6-K containing a management proposal for an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 28, 2026. The agenda includes approval of several mergers: Merger Juno, Merger Tijo Energia, Merger Retiro Baixo, and Merger NE Janapu. These are internal reorganizations merging specific entities into the company. The filing serves as a notice and manual for digital participation, with remote voting ballots. While not a standalone spin-off, the mergers may restructure subsidiaries. No exact terms, prices, or advisors are stated. Watch for shareholder approval and integration timeline.
